svg.title: UML class diagram of NEMOS_SimulationAnalysis.py
svg.text: Post-processing of a finished case with PyVista. LoadSimulation opens it; SimulationAnalysis works on the fields, Regularization resamples them onto regular grids.
copied at construction: call sim.set_time() first
Needs a finished case: caso.foam at the root and, for a parallel run,
reconstructPar first. Otherwise only time 0 is visible.
